metadata.description: The Guava Stack for business owners and solo operators: guava-hub, one shared home for your AI context (Notion or a local folder; Google Drive and OneDrive/SharePoint coming soon), a head-chef + line-cook model router, and founder-mode.

plugins.name: guava-hub
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. Sets up guava-hub, one shared home for your context, rules and skills in Notion or a local Markdown or Obsidian folder (Google Drive and OneDrive/SharePoint coming soon), so all your AI assistants share them. Part of the Guava Stack.

plugins.name: guava-router
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. Routes thinking work to a head-chef model and doing work to a line-cook model, through their CLIs or right in your Claude and ChatGPT apps, on the plans you already pay for. Works with Claude + ChatGPT, ChatGPT only, Claude only or Google only, and newer models swap in with a one-line change. Part of the Guava Stack.

plugins.name: founder-mode
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. 27 working rules so your AI assistant handles the safe work on its own and always checks with you before anything that could cost you money or can't be undone. Part of the Guava Stack.
